annotationRationale: The mean restricts the total sum, the median determines the positions of the unknown entries, and the range fixes the endpoints. Linear equations recover the candidates in the exhaustive median cases.
sourceMethod: Followed the official four-case analysis by integer median. Made explicit why each case uses only one of the two possible sums, justified the endpoint cases, and checked every surviving triple.

review.mathCheck: Range 7 forces all entries into [0,8]; the integer median must be 3,4,5 or 6. The total sum is 36 or 45. Median 3 is impossible; medians 4,5,6 respectively force (0.1,4,7.1), (0,5,6.2), and (6,6.2,8). These satisfy the ordering, range and integer-mean conditions. The endpoint cases are exhaustive, confirming exactly 3 triples, choice C.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded expansion of MAA solution 15, page 7. It follows the official sum restriction and four median cases, while supplying the order-count arguments, exclusions of the alternative sums, and final verification.
review.annotationCheck: Mean, median and range are appropriately assessed; cnm_042 is appropriate routine equation-solving support. The named steps do not claim assessment of the bundled mode, variance or standard-deviation content.
